brief: Why you should aim to be disliked by 50% of your audience.

slots.title: WHY HALF YOUR AUDIENCE SHOULD HATE YOU
PLEASING EVERYONE DESTROYS YOU
slots.body: When you try to appeal to everyone, you dilute your message into beige nothingness. Strong brands stand for something specific, which naturally repels the wrong people. That repulsion is a feature, not a bug.

slots.title: ATTENTION LIVES IN TENSION
slots.body: A lukewarm message gets scrolled past in under a second. Controversy and conviction force a reaction—love it or hate it. Neutrality is the true enemy of growth.

slots.title: FILTERS ATTRACT BETTER CLIENTS
slots.body: Disliking you clears out freebie-seekers and bad-fit customers. The 50% who stay are pre-qualified believers willing to pay premium prices. Your roster gets lighter and more profitable.

slots.title: AUTHORITY REQUIRES A SHARP EDGE
slots.body: Experts have enemies; novices have applause. When you stake a claim, you demonstrate the confidence that comes from deep competence. People trust leaders who pick a side.

slots.title: ALGORITHMS REWARD POLARIZATION
slots.body: Social platforms push content that triggers emotion. Indifference kills reach, while debate drives shares, saves, and comments. The algorithm is biased toward boldness.

slots.title: LEGACY IS FOR THE BRAVE
slots.body: History remembers the ones who took a stand, not the ones who hedged every sentence. If half the room isn't disagreeing, you're not saying anything at all.

slots.headline: PICK A FIGHT TODAY
slots.body: Say the thing. Post the take. Your people are waiting on the other side.
